one_line_description.value: Linear is a project and issue tracking tool for software teams (issues, projects, cycles, initiatives, documents) that exposes a public GraphQL API.
one_line_description.quote: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL.

has_public_api.quote: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL.

api_type.quote: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL.

api_breadth.value: GraphQL, full introspectable schema; read queries plus write mutations across all entities
api_breadth.quote: In addition to querying, Linear has full support for mutating all entities.

docs_url.quote: For more in depth documentation visit developers.linear.app.

auth_methods.quote: The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: - `read` - (Default) Read access for the user's account.

access_model.quote: | API and webhook access | Included | Included | Included | Included |

access_notes.value: API and webhook access is included on every plan including Free; credentials are self-serve personal API keys or OAuth2 applications created in Settings. Workspace admins control whether Members may create their own API keys, and creating/managing webhooks requires admin permissions. Rate limits are standard on Free/Basic, 2x on Business and 5x on Enterprise.
access_notes.quote: Admins can choose whether or not Members can create their own API keys from Settings > Administration > API > Member API keys.

official_mcp_server.quote: Read-write access is provided through `https://mcp.linear.app/mcp` by default.

rate_limits.value: API key: 2,500 requests/hour per user; OAuth app: 5,000/hour; unauthenticated: 600/hour per IP address; standard limits included on Free/Basic, 2x on Business and 5x on Enterprise
rate_limits.quote: | API key | 2,500 | User | 1 hour | | OAuth App | 5,000 | User (or App User) | 1 hour | | Unauthenticated | 600 | IP Address | 1 hour |

webhooks.quote: Linear provides webhooks which allow you to receive HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed.

sdk_languages.quote: It is written in TypeScript, allowing all operations to be strongly typed.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Docs include a dedicated 'Deprecations' section under the GraphQL API, but the actual versioning scheme and sunset policy text was not captured in the supplied evidence.

verdict_reason: Linear's public GraphQL API is documented at developers.linear.app with OAuth2 and personal API keys, documented scopes, and full read/write mutations across all entities. API and webhook access is included even on the Free plan, and credentials are self-serve (personal API keys or OAuth apps created in settings). Rate limits are published (2,500 req/hour with an API key, 5,000 for OAuth apps) and official TypeScript SDK, webhooks, and a hosted MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp are available.
open_questions: No documented sandbox or test environment was found in the supplied sources; developers likely test against a real free workspace, but this is not confirmed by evidence.
The Deprecations page (https://linear.app/developers/deprecations) was returned by search but its text was not included in the evidence, so the concrete API versioning/sunset policy is unverified.
No community/third-party MCP servers were listed in the evidence (MCP registry and GitHub searches returned nothing); only Linear's official server is confirmed.
Whether workspace admins disabling Member API keys is a common default is not stated; admin-level access may be required in some organizations to obtain keys or create webhooks.
